text:
Generate the NEXT animation drawing immediately after this approved KH2 Sora idle sprite, only a small anticipation step into running. One complete illustration, white square canvas, exact same right-facing three-quarter camera, character scale, face, outfit, boots, cel shading and linework as the reference. Preserve its existing canvas placement and generous margins; do not zoom in.




This is frame01, about60ms after the idle. Both boot soles remain planted in the SAME places. Bend both knees slightly more and lower the pelvis about6 pixels in the reference's512px coordinate space. Redraw the knees, hips, jacket and elbows anatomically for that compression. Tip the torso forward slightly; move the face about3 pixels right and4 pixels down, keeping its size. The boots and feet stay fixed. This must be a genuine joint change, not translation or scaling of the whole pose.




At this first small anticipation step BOTH hands still hold the existing low grip. Move the hands/connected weapon together about2 pixels right and4 pixels down. Keep the Kingdom Key's original diagonal up-left angle and exact design/proportions: one straight silver shaft aligned with black handle and blue collar, unchanged gold guard, unchanged three-tooth crown shape, attached pommel chain. Do not lengthen, shorten, bend or redesign it. No shoulder carry or stride yet; those come in later drawings. Exactly two anatomically complete arms and hands, same KH2 costume details. Draw only this next complete frame, no sheet, text, arrows, trails, floor lines or separate layers.
